payout_quote: New members and the referring members will receive the $90 bonus deposit to the Regular Share (savings) account within 120 days of opening qualifying accounts.
steps: Be an AmFirst member 18+ in good standing with a Regular Share account
Share your unique referral code with a friend
Friend enters your referral code at application and opens a personal (not business) checking account in-branch or online
Friend meets the transaction requirements within 30 days; both accounts stay open and in good standing for 90 days
You receive the $90 bonus deposit within 120 days of the qualifying account opening
catches: Maximum of five bonuses per referring member for the entire promotion ($450 total)
Referred friends must not have had an AmFirst checking account, and ex-members who rejoin within six months do not qualify
Referral code must be entered at application — AmFirst will not pay for accounts opened without the code
Friend must meet transaction requirements within 30 days and accounts must stay open 90 days
Payout takes up to 120 days; reported as interest income to the IRS
Cannot be combined with other promotions; AmFirst may terminate at any time
biggest_catch: You can only earn five $90 bonuses total — and your payout takes up to 120 days.
eligibility: AmFirst members 18+ in good standing with a Regular Share account; friends 18+ with no existing AmFirst checking, eligible for membership
timing: Within 120 days of opening the qualifying accounts
